=== the win/loss gate, as a hypothesis test ===
  A "k of n paired wins" rule is a SIGN TEST. Under the null (the lever does
  nothing) each seed is a coin flip, so the gate fires by chance at:
  rule           P(fire|null) across 1 rungs
  4 of 4         0.0625       0.0625
  3 of 4         0.3125       0.3125
  The sign test also DISCARDS MAGNITUDE: a 0.01 deg loss and a 0.77 deg loss
  count the same. Prefer the mean delta and its CI above for the verdict.
